evidence: Failure to adapt to a rapidly-changing technological environment or failure to adopt emerging technologies in a timely manner could result in negative impacts to our business.
The development and use or misuse of AI, and the failure to use AI, present risks and challenges that may negatively impact our business.
We face risks that we will fail to combat the offensive use of AI sufficiently or that we will fail to deploy defensive tools using AI adequately.

If we or our business partners use AI to make decisions that affect consumers, employees or job applicants, the AI may be subject to biases or other types of unfair decision-making that may negatively impact those individuals.
Uncertainty in the regulatory regime relating to AI may require significant resources to modify and maintain business practices.
ai_positioning.summary: VFC adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur les risques réglementaires, de cybersécurité, de biais algorithmique et de conformité plutôt que sur une stratégie d'adoption offensive ou de leadership technologique.
